2026-08-28.text: First, I listen to a short story.
Then I read the text and check difficult words.
2026-08-28.zh: 然后我阅读文本并查看难词。

2026-08-28.text: I listen again without the text.
I think this practice is useful.
2026-08-28.zh: 我认为这种练习很有用。

2026-08-28.text: I do not need a long recording.
2026-08-28.zh: 我不需要一段很长的录音。

2026-08-28.text: I need to understand a short one well.
2026-08-28.zh: 我需要把一段短录音听懂。

2026-08-29.text: Our reading group begins at four today.
2026-08-29.zh: 我们的阅读小组今天四点开始。

2026-08-29.text: Please bring your book and a pen.
2026-08-29.zh: 请带上你的书和一支笔。

2026-08-29.text: We read one short story together.
2026-08-29.zh: 我们一起读一个短故事。

2026-08-29.text: You can ask questions when you do not understand.
2026-08-29.zh: 有不明白的地方时，你可以提问。

2026-08-29.text: Before you leave, please write one sentence about the story.
2026-08-29.zh: 离开前，请写一句与这个故事有关的话。

2026-08-29.text: Do not forget your book on the table.

2026-08-30.text: Our lesson begins at nine today, not at eight.
2026-08-30.zh: 我们今天九点上课，不是八点。

2026-08-30.text: I arrived early yesterday because I did not check the message.
2026-08-30.zh: 我昨天早到了，因为我没有查看消息。

2026-08-30.text: Please read the new time before you leave home.
2026-08-30.zh: 请在离家前查看新的时间。

2026-08-30.text: We can meet at the door at ten to nine.
2026-08-30.zh: 我们可以八点五十分在门口见。

2026-08-30.text: Tomorrow the lesson will begin at eight again.
2026-08-30.zh: 明天课程又会在八点开始。

2026-08-31.text: The small library is between the science building and the dining hall.
2026-08-31.zh: 小图书馆位于科学楼和食堂之间。

2026-08-31.text: It opens at eight in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
2026-08-31.zh: 它早上八点开门，晚上六点关门。

2026-08-31.text: There are quiet rooms on the second floor.
You can read your course notes there after class.
2026-08-31.zh: 下课后你可以在那里看课程笔记。

2026-08-31.text: Please speak quietly and keep your phone in your bag.
2026-08-31.zh: 请轻声说话，并把手机放在包里。

2026-09-01.text: Could you help me with this sentence?
2026-09-01.zh: 你能帮我看一下这个句子吗？

2026-09-01.text: I know most of the words,
but I cannot find the main verb.
I do not need the full answer yet.
2026-09-01.zh: 我暂时不需要完整答案。

2026-09-01.text: Please show me the subject first.
Then I want to try again.
If I still have a problem,

2026-09-02.text: Let us stop for ten minutes.
2026-09-02.zh: 让我们停下来休息十分钟。

2026-09-02.text: We can drink some water and walk outside.
2026-09-02.zh: 我们可以喝点水，到外面走走。

2026-09-02.text: we will check the last two questions.
2026-09-02.zh: 我们会检查最后两道题。

2026-09-02.text: We do not need to finish every exercise tonight.
2026-09-02.zh: 我们今晚不必做完每一道练习。

2026-09-02.text: We can continue the work tomorrow morning
2026-09-02.zh: 我们可以明天早上继续学习，
那时我们的精力会更充足。

2026-09-03.text: We will meet in the small library today.
2026-09-03.zh: 我们今天会在小图书馆见面。

2026-09-03.text: Please arrive at four and bring your notebook.
2026-09-03.zh: 请四点到，并带上笔记本。

2026-09-03.text: We will read a short story and discuss two questions.
2026-09-03.zh: 我们会读一个短故事并讨论两个问题。

2026-09-03.text: You do not need to learn new words before the meeting.
2026-09-03.zh: 见面前你不需要学习新单词。

2026-09-03.text: Today we are checking what we remember from this week.
2026-09-03.zh: 今天我们要检查自己记住了本周的哪些内容。

2026-09-04.text: I am making a plan for tomorrow.
2026-09-04.zh: 我正在为明天制订计划。

2026-09-04.text: I have two classes in the morning,
so I will study English after lunch.
2026-09-04.zh: 所以我会在午饭后学习英语。

2026-09-04.text: First, I will review old words.
Then I will listen to a short dialogue.
2026-09-04.zh: 然后我会听一段简短对话。

2026-09-04.text: I want to choose tasks that I can finish.
2026-09-04.zh: 我想选择自己能够完成的任务。

2026-09-04.text: I can change the plan if a task takes more time.
2026-09-04.zh: 如果某项任务花费更多时间，我可以调整计划。

2026-09-05.text: This small dictionary costs twenty yuan.
2026-09-05.zh: 这本小词典售价二十元。

2026-09-05.text: but the examples are easier to read.
2026-09-05.zh: 但里面的例句更容易读懂。

2026-09-05.text: You can open both books and compare one word.
2026-09-05.zh: 你可以翻开两本书，比较其中一个单词。

2026-09-05.text: If you want to save money,
there are used books on the other table.
2026-09-05.zh: 另一张桌子上有二手书。

2026-09-05.text: Please check the pages before you pay.

2026-09-06.text: Are you free after four today?
2026-09-06.zh: 你今天四点以后有空吗？

2026-09-06.text: Our study group will meet in room six.
2026-09-06.zh: 我们的学习小组将在六号房间见面。

2026-09-06.text: Please try the first two questions alone before you come.
2026-09-06.zh: 来之前请先独立完成前两道题。

2026-09-06.text: We will share our answers and explain our reasons.
2026-09-06.zh: 我们会分享答案并解释理由。

2026-09-06.text: you can send us your questions later.
2026-09-06.zh: 可以稍后把问题发给我们。

2026-09-06.text: We will meet again on Friday.
2026-09-06.zh: 我们星期五会再次见面。

2026-09-07.text: Please turn off the sound on your phone for this task.
2026-09-07.zh: 做这项任务时，请关闭手机声音。

2026-09-07.text: Put it in your bag and open the short text.
2026-09-07.zh: 把手机放进包里，然后打开短文。

2026-09-07.text: Read for twenty minutes, but do not rush.
2026-09-07.zh: 阅读二十分钟，但不要着急。

2026-09-07.text: At the end, close the text
and tell your partner the main idea.
Then you can check your messages during the break.
2026-09-07.zh: 之后你可以在休息期间查看消息。

2026-09-08.text: The train to Green Village leaves at eight thirty today.
2026-09-08.zh: 开往绿村的火车今天八点半发车。

2026-09-08.text: Please arrive at the station before eight fifteen.
2026-09-08.zh: 请在八点十五分之前到达车站。

2026-09-08.text: The small shop near the door sells water,
but you cannot pay there with a card.
2026-09-08.zh: 但在那里不能刷卡付款。

2026-09-08.text: ask the person at the information desk.
2026-09-08.zh: 请询问信息台的工作人员。

2026-09-09.text: Today I am reviewing words from last week.
2026-09-09.zh: 今天我正在复习上周的单词。

2026-09-09.text: I cover the meanings and try to remember them first.
2026-09-09.zh: 我先遮住词义，尝试回忆这些单词。

2026-09-09.text: Then I use each difficult word in a short sentence.
2026-09-09.zh: 然后我用每个难词造一个短句。

2026-09-09.text: I do not copy the same word twenty times.
2026-09-09.zh: 我不会把同一个单词抄写二十遍。

2026-09-09.text: I check it again after a break.
2026-09-09.zh: 休息后我会再次检查它。

2026-09-09.text: This helps me see which words need more practice.
2026-09-09.zh: 这能帮助我看出哪些单词需要更多练习。

2026-09-10.text: Our review meeting starts at five,
2026-09-10.zh: 我们的复盘会五点开始，

2026-09-10.text: but please come ten minutes early.
Bring your record of old mistakes.
We will listen to a new conversation and answer two questions
2026-09-10.zh: 我们会听一段新对话并回答两个问题，

2026-09-10.text: Then we will choose next week’s tasks.
2026-09-10.zh: 然后我们会选择下周的任务。

2026-09-10.text: We are checking what to practise next,
2026-09-10.zh: 我们是在检查下一步要练什么，

2026-09-10.text: not trying to learn many new words today.
2026-09-10.zh: 而不是要在今天学习许多新词。

2026-09-11.text: This afternoon's study-skills class will not meet in Room 210.
2026-09-11.zh: 今天下午的学习技巧课不在210教室上课。

2026-09-11.text: Please go to Room 315 in the science building instead.
The science building is across from the library,
and its west entrance is open.
Class still begins at two thirty,
2026-09-11.zh: 课程仍然在两点半开始，
所以请提前五分钟到达，

2026-09-11.text: and bring your campus map if you need it.
2026-09-11.zh: 如果需要，请带上校园地图。

2026-09-12.text: Our group report is due next Monday.
2026-09-12.zh: 我们的小组报告下周一到期。

2026-09-12.text: I can collect the information tonight,
and Maya will organize the notes tomorrow.
Ben planned to make the slides on Saturday,
2026-09-12.zh: 本原计划星期六制作幻灯片，

2026-09-12.text: but he has a sports event then,
2026-09-12.zh: 但他那时有一场体育活动，

2026-09-12.text: so he will finish them on Sunday morning.
2026-09-12.zh: 所以他会在星期日上午完成幻灯片。

2026-09-12.text: Let us check everything together at four on Sunday afternoon
2026-09-12.zh: 让我们星期日下午四点一起检查全部内容，

2026-09-12.text: and leave time for one final change.
2026-09-12.zh: 并留出时间做最后一次修改。

2026-09-13.text: I am looking for reliable information about public transport,
2026-09-13.zh: 我正在查找有关公共交通的可靠资料，

2026-09-13.text: but I do not know which database to use.
2026-09-13.zh: 但我不知道该使用哪个数据库。

2026-09-13.text: Start with the social science database on the library website.
2026-09-13.zh: 先使用图书馆网站上的社会科学数据库。

2026-09-13.text: Search for articles published in the last five years,
2026-09-13.zh: 搜索过去五年内发表的文章，
并记下每项资料的出处。

2026-09-13.text: You can borrow the transport report on this desk,
2026-09-13.zh: 你可以借阅这张桌子上的交通报告，

2026-09-13.text: but please return it by next Wednesday.
2026-09-13.zh: 但请在下周三之前归还。

2026-09-14.text: so try to arrive by seven forty-five.
2026-09-14.zh: 所以尽量在七点四十五分前到达。

2026-09-14.text: Prepare your pencils and student card tonight
2026-09-14.zh: 今晚准备好铅笔和学生证，

2026-09-14.text: instead of searching for them in the morning.
2026-09-14.zh: 不要等到早上再到处找。

2026-09-14.text: Do not stay up late to learn every detail.
2026-09-14.zh: 不要为了掌握每个细节而熬夜。

2026-09-14.text: Review your short notes, turn off your phone,
2026-09-14.zh: 复习简短的笔记，关掉手机，

2026-09-14.text: A clear mind will help you read the questions carefully.
2026-09-14.zh: 清醒的头脑会帮助你仔细阅读题目。

2026-09-15.text: Please upload your reading summary to the class platform
2026-09-15.zh: 请把阅读摘要上传到班级平台，

2026-09-15.text: and put your student number in the file name.
2026-09-15.zh: 并在文件名中写上学号。

2026-09-15.text: After uploading, open the file once
2026-09-15.zh: 上传后，把文件打开一次，

2026-09-15.text: send the file to the course email before the deadline
2026-09-15.zh: 请在截止时间前把文件发送到课程邮箱，

2026-09-15.text: and try the platform again later.

2026-09-16.zh: 在星期六的社区活动之前，

2026-09-16.text: Mei and Arun will prepare the tables at nine.
2026-09-16.zh: 梅和阿伦会在九点布置桌子。

2026-09-16.text: Rosa will welcome families at the entrance,
2026-09-16.zh: 罗莎会在入口处迎接各个家庭，

2026-09-16.text: while I will lead the first reading group.
2026-09-16.zh: 而我会带领第一个阅读小组。

2026-09-16.text: Sam cannot come in the morning,
so he will clean the room after the event instead.
2026-09-16.zh: 所以他会改在活动结束后打扫房间。

2026-09-16.text: tell the group before Friday evening.
2026-09-16.zh: 请在星期五晚上之前告诉小组。

2026-09-17.text: This week I completed five full study days.
2026-09-17.zh: 本周我完成了五个完整学习日。
阅读是我表现最好的部分，

2026-09-17.text: but I missed three listening questions about time.
2026-09-17.zh: 但我答错了三道与时间有关的听力题。

2026-09-17.text: I also spelled four familiar words incorrectly.
2026-09-17.zh: 我还拼错了四个熟悉的单词。

2026-09-17.text: Next week I will keep the same number of daily tasks.
2026-09-17.zh: 下周我会保持每天相同的任务量。

2026-09-17.text: and my first four review words
2026-09-17.zh: 而且我的前四个复习词，

2026-09-17.text: will come from this week's spelling errors.
2026-09-17.zh: 将来自本周拼错的单词。

2026-09-18.text: We need cups for the student café.
Paper cups are cheaper to buy today,
2026-09-18.zh: 纸杯现在购买起来更便宜，

2026-09-18.text: but we would need hundreds every week.
2026-09-18.zh: 但我们每周都需要几百个。

2026-09-18.text: These washable cups cost more at first
2026-09-18.zh: 这些可清洗的杯子起初成本更高，

2026-09-18.text: and can be used many times.

2026-09-18.zh: 所以清洗它们是可行的。

2026-09-18.text: Let us order fifty washable cups
2026-09-18.zh: 让我们订购五十个可清洗的杯子，

2026-09-18.text: and keep a small number of paper ones for busy events.
2026-09-18.zh: 并为繁忙的活动保留少量纸杯。

2026-09-19.text: Hello, this is the student services office
2026-09-19.zh: 你好，这里是学生服务办公室，

2026-09-19.text: We would like to interview you on Tuesday
2026-09-19.zh: 我们想在星期二面试你，
时间是三点十五分，地点在408房间。

2026-09-19.text: and a copy of your class schedule.
The position includes two weekday evenings and Saturday morning.
2026-09-19.zh: 这个岗位的工作时间包括两个工作日的晚上和星期六上午。

2026-09-19.text: You do not need previous office experience,
2026-09-19.zh: 你不需要以往的办公室工作经验，

2026-09-19.text: how you communicate with other people.
2026-09-19.zh: 你是如何与他人沟通的。

2026-09-20.text: When Lara said, “Come by around seven,”
2026-09-20.zh: 当拉拉说“七点左右过来”时，

2026-09-20.text: I was not sure whether she meant exactly seven.
2026-09-20.zh: 我不确定她是否指必须正好七点到。

2026-09-20.text: I asked, “Do you mean I should arrive at seven,
2026-09-20.zh: 我问：“你的意思是我应该七点到，

2026-09-20.text: or is a little later all right?”
Lara explained that any time between seven and seven thirty was fine.
2026-09-20.zh: 拉拉解释说，七点到七点半之间的任何时间都可以。

2026-09-20.text: and arrived at seven fifteen with a small dessert to share.
2026-09-20.zh: 并在七点十五分带着一份供大家分享的小甜点到达。

2026-09-21.text: This is a message for students
2026-09-21.zh: 这是一则给学生的通知，

2026-09-21.text: attending Professor Hall's lecture this afternoon.
2026-09-21.zh: 这些学生将参加今天下午霍尔教授的讲座。

2026-09-21.text: The lecture will begin at three as planned,
2026-09-21.zh: 讲座会按计划在三点开始，

2026-09-21.text: but it has moved from Room 204 to Room 310
2026-09-21.zh: 但地点已从204教室改到310教室，

2026-09-21.text: because the first room has a technical problem.
2026-09-21.zh: 因为原教室出现了技术问题。

2026-09-21.text: Please bring a notebook and arrive five minutes early.
2026-09-21.zh: 请带上笔记本并提前五分钟到达。

2026-09-21.text: The professor will answer questions during the final ten minutes.
2026-09-21.zh: 教授会在最后十分钟回答问题。

2026-09-22.text: If you are starting your first research report,
2026-09-22.zh: 如果你正开始写第一份研究报告，

2026-09-22.text: do not search the whole internet at once.
2026-09-22.zh: 不要一开始就在整个互联网上搜索。
先从图书馆数据库入手，

2026-09-22.text: and use two or three clear key words.
2026-09-22.zh: 并使用两三个明确的关键词。

2026-09-22.text: Then check the author's name, the publication date,
2026-09-22.zh: 然后检查作者姓名、发表日期，

2026-09-22.text: bring your topic to the information desk.
2026-09-22.zh: 请带着你的选题到信息台咨询。

2026-09-23.zh: 在结束今天的会议之前，

2026-09-23.text: Sara will complete the survey questions by Thursday noon.
2026-09-23.zh: 萨拉会在星期四中午前完成调查问题。

2026-09-23.text: and collect their answers by Saturday.
2026-09-23.zh: 并在星期六前收集他们的答案。

2026-09-23.text: I will organize the results on Sunday morning.
2026-09-23.zh: 我会在星期日上午整理结果。

2026-09-23.text: Please put your work in the shared folder
2026-09-23.zh: 请把你的成果放入共享文件夹，

2026-09-23.text: as soon as it is ready.
We will meet online at seven on Sunday evening
2026-09-23.zh: 我们会在星期日晚上七点线上见面，

2026-09-24.text: you will not learn new words.
First, listen to a short message twice
2026-09-24.zh: 首先，把一段简短消息听两遍，

2026-09-24.text: and answer two questions without reading the text.
2026-09-24.zh: 并在不看文本的情况下回答两个问题。

2026-09-24.text: and underline the clue for each answer.
2026-09-24.zh: 并画出每个答案的依据。

2026-09-24.text: and mark the sentence that supports every choice.
2026-09-24.zh: 并标出支持每个选项的句子。
但要在提交所有部分之后。

2026-09-25.text: The student health center will offer a forty-minute workshop
2026-09-25.zh: 学生健康中心将举办一场四十分钟的讲座，
时间是星期二晚上六点。

2026-09-25.text: how regular meals, water, and sleep can affect concentration.
2026-09-25.zh: 规律进餐、饮水和睡眠会如何影响注意力。

2026-09-25.text: This is not a cooking class,
and no food will be served.
Please bring a record of one normal study day
2026-09-25.zh: 请带上一份普通学习日的记录，
如果你想得到个性化建议。

2026-09-25.text: but you need to register online by Monday.
2026-09-25.zh: 但你需要在星期一之前在线报名。

2026-09-26.text: Thank you for volunteering at River Park this Saturday.
2026-09-26.zh: 感谢你报名参加本周六的河滨公园志愿活动。

2026-09-26.text: Please meet beside the east gate at eight thirty,
2026-09-26.zh: 请八点半在东门旁集合，

2026-09-26.text: The organizer will provide gloves and rubbish bags,
2026-09-26.zh: 组织者会提供手套和垃圾袋，

2026-09-26.text: but you should bring water and wear closed shoes.
2026-09-26.zh: 但你应该带水并穿包住脚趾的鞋。
另一组会记录损坏的标牌。

2026-09-26.text: The activity will end at eleven.

2026-09-27.text: the library will use three kinds of waste bins.
2026-09-27.zh: 图书馆将使用三种垃圾桶。

2026-09-27.text: Blue bins are for clean paper,
2026-09-27.zh: 蓝色垃圾桶用于投放干净的纸张，

2026-09-27.text: yellow bins are for plastic bottles,
2026-09-27.zh: 黄色垃圾桶用于投放塑料瓶，

2026-09-27.text: and gray bins are for other waste.
2026-09-27.zh: 灰色垃圾桶用于投放其他垃圾。

2026-09-27.text: The old bins beside the front doors will be removed.
2026-09-27.zh: 正门旁边的旧垃圾桶将被移走。

2026-09-27.text: New bins will be placed on every floor near the stairs,
2026-09-27.zh: 每一层楼的楼梯附近都会放置新垃圾桶，

2026-09-27.text: where they are easier to find.

2026-09-28.text: Welcome to the quiet study room on the second floor.
2026-09-28.zh: 欢迎来到二楼的安静自习室。
这里允许使用笔记本电脑和平板电脑，

2026-09-28.text: but all devices must remain silent.
2026-09-28.zh: 但所有设备都必须保持静音。

2026-09-28.text: If you need to join an online meeting,
2026-09-28.zh: 如果你需要参加线上会议，

2026-09-28.text: please use one of the rooms across the hall.
2026-09-28.zh: 请使用走廊对面的某个房间。

2026-09-28.text: Phone calls are not permitted here.
You may leave your seat for a short break,
2026-09-28.zh: 你可以暂时离开座位休息一下，

2026-09-28.text: but take valuable devices with you.
2026-09-28.zh: 但请随身带走贵重设备。

2026-09-28.text: The room closes at ten tonight.

2026-09-29.text: The career center's interview workshop will take place this Wednesday
2026-09-29.zh: 就业指导中心的面试培训将在本周三举行，

2026-09-29.text: an adviser will explain six common interview questions.
2026-09-29.zh: 一位指导老师会讲解六个常见面试问题。

2026-09-29.text: students will practise answers in pairs and receive feedback.
2026-09-29.zh: 学生会两人一组练习回答并获得反馈。

2026-09-29.text: Bring a printed copy of your resume
and one internship notice that interests you.
2026-09-29.zh: 以及一则你感兴趣的实习通知。

2026-09-29.text: Places are limited to twenty students,
so register through the career center website tonight.
2026-09-29.zh: 所以请今晚通过就业指导中心网站报名。

2026-09-30.text: Because of road repairs near North Gate,
2026-09-30.zh: 由于北门附近正在修路，

2026-09-30.text: Bus Route 6 will follow a temporary route
2026-09-30.zh: 6路公交车将按临时路线行驶，
时间为星期三至星期五。

2026-09-30.text: Buses will not stop at North Gate or Science Hall.
2026-09-30.zh: 公交车不会在北门或科学楼停靠。

2026-09-30.text: should use the temporary station beside the sports center.
2026-09-30.zh: 应使用体育中心旁的临时车站。

2026-09-30.text: Morning and evening times will remain the same,
2026-09-30.zh: 早晚的发车时间将保持不变，

2026-09-30.text: but journeys may take about ten minutes longer.
2026-09-30.zh: 但路程可能会多花大约十分钟。

2026-09-30.text: Check the transport website before leaving.
2026-09-30.zh: 出发前请查看交通网站。
